title: The Cold Anvil
text: An anvil that has not been struck in an age, rimed with frost in a room where the coals still glow. Beside it stands a smith's ghost, leather apron and all. It mends whatever arm strikes it, the ghost says, if the arm is honest about the blow.

options.label: The one with the hurt arm strikes the anvil.

outcomes.text: The ring of it goes up the bone like cold fire. The arm is whole.
The anvil rings, and the arm goes numb, and stays a little numb.

options.label: The strongest works the anvil for the ghost.

outcomes.text: A blade the ghost is proud of. It nods once, and fades into the frost.

options.label: Take the anvil for the House.

outcomes.text: Heavy as sin, and the ghost follows it, and stands behind whoever carries it.
